career.title: Career Timeline
career.subtitle: My professional journey in mobile development and software engineering.

achievements: Significantly contributed to the Salesman App, a key component of Astra's frontliner mobile solutions, which received an Asian Technology Excellence Award for its impact on operational productivity and customer experience in the automotive sector.

Developed and refined the user interface for key sections of the Salesman App using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, focusing on enhancing user experience and contributing to an accelerated development lifecycle for faster feature delivery.
Led bug fixing and feature enhancements for iOS applications using Swift, ensuring optimal performance and user satisfaction.
Collaborated closely with the Product Team to align on app functionalities and implement effective solutions.
Maintained and enhanced features for a P2P fintech mobile application on Android using Kotlin, improving functionality and user engagement.
Addressed and resolved critical issues to ensure app reliability and performance.
